### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/service-realtime`, touching **16** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/plugins/packages.mdx`  _(via sys_presence (symbol, a field of const object arObjects; a field of const object deObjects; a field of const object frObjects; a field of const object koObjects; a field of const object ptBRObjects; a field of const object ruObjects; a field of const object zhHantObjects))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via sys_presence (symbol, a field of const object arObjects; a field of const object deObjects; a field of const object frObjects; a field of const object koObjects; a field of const object ptBRObjects; a field of const object ruObjects; a field of const object zhHantObjects))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **8** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c22f43180eea1d4f625e170fc2930897edb694e9` — the merge of head `28ebd23538960465127b51dce81e107659927e8a` into base `fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c22f43180eea1d4f625e170fc2930897edb694e9 && git checkout c22f43180eea1d4f625e170fc2930897edb694e9
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a 28ebd23538960465127b51dce81e107659927e8a && git checkout -B drift-repro fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a && git merge --no-ff 28ebd23538960465127b51dce81e107659927e8a

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs fa9c0aa2a0a8c2752f83b57765f3aae978ae196a` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** `service-realtime` 的在线状态对象（`sys_presence`）补齐 7 种语言：繁體中文、阿拉伯语、法语、巴西葡语、俄语、德语、韩语。按平台语言表的标签注册，原有 4 种语言不动。
- **为什么改：** 平台语言表定了 11 种语言，每种都要在所有界面上完整（#29428 裁定 F）。平台元数据原来只有 4 种（#30512，11 个包中的第 1 个）。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加翻译内容和注册行，不改任何行为；没有翻译的请求照旧回落英文。回滚即撤本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/services/service-realtime/src/translations/index.ts` 的注册行，再挑一种语言的 `*.objects.generated.ts` 看译文。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-realtime test`。
- **需要您做的：** 无，席位经合并队列落地（非受管面，733 行，非 BREAKING）。
- **席位意见：** ACCEPT。席位抽查了繁中、阿语、韩语译文，术语一致、通顺；与英文相同的值（如德语的 Status、Online）由 source-hashes 记录，下次抽取不会误判为过期。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:server#2 · head `28ebd23538960465127b51dce81e107659927e8a`

- **形态:** draft, author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay `pr_create`), no assignee, no review request; 18 files, +731 −2; `check-governed-merges --pr 30536`: NOT governed (0 of 18 paths), 733 lines ≤ 3000. Title has no `!`. `Refs #30512` (package 1 of 11; the card stays open).
- **Review face:** `TIER_DEFAULT` (`Clause-②: no`: translated content for locales the platform table already declares, plus registration lines; no spec, governed or narrowing path), written here by the seat.
- **Seat rulings held:** new files under the table tags (`zh-Hant`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de`, `ko`); existing `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES` untouched; `zh-CN` registered ahead of `zh-Hant` (the resolver's prefix fallback keeps today's `zh-TW` → `zh-CN` answer; the resolver gap is filed separately from the dev's report).
- **Seat read:** `index.ts` and `scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts` register the seven bundles and their source hashes; the extract docstring's `--locales` now lists all eleven, so the existing `check-i18n-bundles` covers this package for the new locales (no new gate, ruling F). Source-hash files carry only the keys whose value equals English (none for `ko`/`ar`/`ru`/`zh-Hant`; e.g. `de` `Status`, `Online`, `Offline`, `Desktop`, `Tablet`), as the generator writes them. `bundle-ownership.test.ts`: one message wording ("every locale bundle"). Spot check of `zh-Hant` (線上狀態 / 建立時間), `ar` (الحضور / تاريخ الإنشاء, RTL text, no Latin left), `ko` (접속 상태 / 생성 일시): consistent with the existing three translations' terms.
- **Dev readings (`28ebd235`):** package tests 35/35, typecheck, `check:i18n`, stale-fill green; derived gates 62 — 61 exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, exit 3: shallow clone without its pinned fixture commit; the PR touches no plugin teardown, and CI runs the family). Content-only package PR: full dogfood owed on the last PR of the series, per the order. os-dev-report 6660732929.
- **Out of scope → carrier:** the locale resolver does not read `platformLocaleTagOf` (`zh-TW` / `zh-HK` keep resolving to `zh-CN` even once `zh-Hant` exists) — the seat files it from the report.
- **门禁 check-runs:** in progress at ACCEPT; the seat queues once every check is green or an expected skip.
- **落地条款:** Refs #30512. Ordinary queue landing by this seat: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` on this head; the card ticks `service-realtime` when it merges.
